sections.title: Functions of the colon
sections.subtitle: Secretory, digestive, and absorptive roles
sections.imageAlt: Educational chart on colon functions for vitamins, minerals, and gut flora
sections.summary: A healthy colon supports digestion, absorbs water and nutrients, and maintains beneficial gut flora. When waste builds up, toxins can be reabsorbed—a concern addressed through professional colon hydrotherapy at our clinic.

topics.heading: What the colon does
bullets: Secretes mucus to protect the intestinal lining
Digests remaining food with help from beneficial bacteria
Absorbs water, electrolytes, and some water-soluble nutrients
Processes about 350 g of fluid chyme daily into formed stool

topics.heading: Gut flora and wellness
bullets: Beneficial bacteria (e.g. Bifidobacterium, Lactobacillus) support vitamin production and immunity
Imbalanced flora can contribute to discomfort and poor absorption
Colon cleansing supports natural elimination when guided by a practitioner

topics.heading: Why this matters for your care
bullets: Understanding colon function helps explain the benefits of in-clinic hydrotherapy
Our team uses evidence-based, drug-free methods aligned with naturopathic practice
Book a free check-up to discuss whether colon hydrotherapy is right for you

sections.title: Intestinal parasites & gut health
sections.subtitle: Awareness and when to seek care
sections.imageAlt: Educational chart on intestinal parasites and common symptoms
sections.summary: Parasites such as tapeworms, pinworms, and others can affect digestion and overall wellness. Symptoms vary; professional assessment and colon hydrotherapy may be part of a holistic care plan at ECOWEALTH Wellnessolution.

topics.heading: How exposure can occur
bullets: Undercooked meat or contaminated food and water
Tapeworms and other parasites can live in the intestines for extended periods

topics.heading: When to consult us
bullets: Persistent digestive symptoms without clear cause
Unexplained weight loss, fatigue, or appetite changes
Interest in parasite support alongside colon cleansing — discuss at your visit
